title: CoPre-MoE: Consolidating and Preserving MoE for Multimodal Continual Instruction Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2611.18417v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal continual instruction tuning requires multimodal large language models to sequentially acquire new capabilities without catastrophic forgetting. Mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures offer a promising way to mitigate task interference through expert specialization and combination. However, while existing MoE-based methods avoid overwriting shared parameters by allocating separate experts for each task, this progressive expansion incurs severe cross-task redundancy and linear parameter growth. Specifically, experts across tasks often learn overlapping functions alongside task-specific capabilities. For instance, ScienceQA and TextVQA both locate relevant image regions. To curb parameter redundancy without inducing forgetting, we propose Consolidating and Preserving MoE (CoPre-MoE). translated_title: CoPre-MoE：面向多模态持续指令微调的专家混合模型整合与保留方法
translated_abstract: 多模态持续指令微调要求多模态大语言模型在依次获取新能力的同时不发生灾难性遗忘。专家混合（MoE）架构通过专家专业化与组合，为缓解任务间干扰提供了一种有前景的途径。然而，现有基于MoE的方法通过为每个任务分配独立专家来避免覆盖共享参数，但这种渐进式扩展会导致严重的跨任务冗余和参数线性增长。具体而言，不同任务的专家在学习任务特定能力的同时，往往会学到重叠的功能。例如，ScienceQA和TextVQA都需要定位相关的图像区域。为了在不引发遗忘的情况下抑制参数冗余，我们提出了整合与保留MoE（CoPre-MoE）。对于每个到来的任务，CoPre-MoE首先学习任务特定的MoE以捕捉专门化能力，从而消除冗余并减少参数……（摘要不完整）
tldr: 提出CoPre-MoE方法，通过为每个任务先学习任务特定MoE专家，再对跨任务冗余专家进行整合与保留，在避免灾难性遗忘的同时有效抑制多模态持续指令微调中的跨任务参数冗余和参数线性增长。
en_tdlr: CoPre-MoE consolidates and preserves redundant cross-task experts in MoE architectures to curb parameter redundancy and linear parameter growth in multimodal continual instruction tuning without inducing catastrophic forgetting.
